integrity: Analytical proof with exact rational, finite exhaustive checks from included standalone Python 3 script; no independent scientific validation.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform percolation bonds on a finite path with a single uniformly random source; not general Markovian SIR and not a claim of unique sign thresholds for arbitrary interior pairs. Historical priority provisional.
title: Endpoint-exception correlations and a sharp boundary-pair crossover in random-source path outbreaks
